questions.question: E, F, G, H, K, L and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between H and G when counted from the right of H. Only three people sit between L and N when counted from the right of N. G sits to the immediate right of N. K sits to the immediate right of E. How many people sit between F and E when counted from the left of F?
questions.solution:
Given:

E, F, G, H, K, L and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only three people sit between L and N when counted from the right of N.

G sits to the immediate right of N.

Only two people sit between H and G when counted from the right of H.

K sits to the immediate right of E

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce5012a11ad65185b1b3b8d2bcd2c073f1d033ca151ac073186baece49d0cd7d.png] 

Thus, 3 people sit between F and E when counted from the left of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:

'U @ S' means 'U is the father of S',

'U * S' means 'U is the husband of S' and

'U # S' means 'U is the mother of S'.

Based on the above, how is B related to E if 'E * L # B @ P'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png]

to S

 
 
 

 

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

Expression: 'E * L # B @ P'

'E * L' means 'E is the husband of L'. 

'L # B' means 'L is the mother of B'.

questions.question: Kunti, Panjiri, Anjali, Hansraj and Roshan are sitting in a circular table facing the centre(but not necessarily in the same order). options.text: Roshan is the immediate neighbour of Hansraj and Kunti.

Panjiri is the immediate neighbour of Hansraj and Anjali.

Kunti, Panjiri, Anjali, Hansraj and Roshan are sitting in a circular table facing the centre.

Roshan is sitting to the immediate right of Hansraj and Hansraj is sitting to the immediate right of Anjali.

Panjiri is the immediate neighbour of Kunti and Roshan.

Thus, Anjali is the immediate neighbour of Kunti and Hansraj.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All lyricists are singers.

Some singers are writers.

No writer is a musician.

**Conclusions:**

(I): No lyricist is a musician.

(II): Some writers are lyricists.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8fe44be5dfb5d0110470b8e935e9075e50d4ca0f0b22d5846dee62427b449ef.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): No lyricist is a musician → False (As, there is no direct relation between lyricist and musician. so, it can be a possibility but definite)

(II): Some writers are lyricists → False (As, there is no direct relation between writers and lyricists, so, it can be a possibility but definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: In a certain code language 'GPZJ' is coded as '98' and 'OWRS' is coded as '66'. What is the code for 'VIXE' in the given language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic:** (Sum of letters reverse position value) × 2 = Number.**

For 'GPZJ' = '98':​

Reverse Position value

G is the 20th 

P is the 11th 

Z is the 1st 

J is the 17th 

(20 + 11 + 1 + 17) × 2

= 98.

For 'OWRS' = '66':

Reverse Position value

O is the 12th 

W is the 4th 

R is the 9th

S is the 8th

(12 + 4 + 9 + 8) × 2

= 66.

Similarly,

For 'VIXE':

Reverse Position value

V is the 5th 

I is the 18th 

X is the 3rd 

E is the 22nd 

(5 + 18 + 3 + 22) × 2

**= 96**.

Thus, the code for 'VIXE' is 96.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
